Chapter 5.4, Instrumentation or Accessory Equipment for Liquid Hydrocarbon Metering Systems, First Edition, 1976 (ANSI/API MPMS 5.4-1976) This publication specifies the characteristics of available and necessary equipment that can be used to attain desired purposes when used in conjunction with volumetric hydrocarbon meters. 7 pages.

Price each, $4.00
